messages:
maya: Hey team — bringing up a new model for catalog + docs + release. Model: Athena-6B (decoder-only, causal). Need intake, quick quant experiments, smoke eval, and announcement copy. Who wants ownership for catalog writeup? :memo:

liam: I can take catalog entry and the quick perf table. Will need sample prompts and a reference eval harness.

olivia: I can run quant baselines (FP16, int8-ggml, AWQ 6/4). Plan: metric set = per-token latency, top-p/temperature nll, and downstream QA accuracy on our evalsuite.

sam: I'll coordinate docs + changelog blurb, and draft the release announcement. Can we gate announcement on no quality regression vs lumen-13b on our SQuAD+CSQA slice?

maya: Good. Priorities: 1) catalog entry + tags, 2) basic stability smoke + rollout policy, 3) quant perf/regression check, 4) announcement scheduling. Estimated timeline: 3 business days for initial triage.

drew: QA note: add a small regression harness that runs 200 prompts from our critical prompts set. If accuracy drop > 2% relative to Lumen-13B FP16, block. I'll run that after quant.

olivia: Quick status after first pass: FP16 median latency 35ms/token on A10G, int8-ggml median 22ms/token, AWQ-6/4 ~20ms/token but AWQ shows slight hallucination spike on long-context tests. I'll attach logs later.

liam: Catalog draft (WIP) — model metadata we want: name, architecture, default checkpoint, quantized variants, recommended config, supported features (streaming, function-calling), sample cost estimate. Proposed small JSON blob for registry (for docs):
```json
{
  "id": "athena-6b",
  "display_name": "Athena 6B",
  "arch": "causal",
  "params": "6B",
  "default_weight": "athena-6b-fp16-v1",
  "variants": ["fp16","int8-ggml","awq-6-4"],
  "recommended": "fp16 for accuracy, awq for cost-sensitive low-latency",
  "features": ["streaming","kv-cache","function-calling"],
  "notes": "Tested on A10G and T4; AWQ shows artifacts on >4k tokens"
}
```

maya: Nice. For the docs page: include a short how-to snippet for requesting the model via API, and example cost/latency table. Sam, can you draft the snippet?

sam: Yep. Draft API snippet (for README):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"athena-6b","input":"Summarize: ...","max_tokens":200}'
```

sam: And a short announcement blurb idea: "Athena-6B: a low-latency, cost-efficient 6B model for retrieval-augmented tasks — FP16 for best quality, AWQ for cost/latency. Available in staging today; GA next week." Thoughts? :rocket:

olivia: Suggest adding caveat about long-context hallucinations with AWQ and recommended fallback to fp16 for critical tasks.

liam: Ops checklist before staging -> prod: 1) tag model in registry (athena-6b-stg-v1), 2) run 1k sample traffic in staging with loadbot, 3) create canary route with 5% traffic, 4) monitor token-level latency and error spikes for 2 hours.

deploy-bot: Build created: athena-6b-stg-v1 on cluster staging-a (image sha: sha256:abcd1234). See CI link: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2345 :white_check_mark:

olivia: I'm seeing a reproducible regression on the 'legal-qa' slice for AWQ-6/4: drop ~3.5% vs fp16. Per Drew's gate, that would block AWQ as default.

drew: Confirmed. Blocker: AWQ default cannot ship for legal-qa. Options: (a) disable AWQ for that slice via routing policy, (b) fallback to fp16 for higher SLAs.

maya: Decision: ship FP16 as default variant for GA. Keep AWQ in catalog as experimental with explicit caveats and per-route opt-in. Update catalog notes accordingly.

sam: I'll update announcement: mark AWQ as "experimental — opt-in, not default" and schedule the post for Thursday 10am PT. Draft copy ready for review in the doc. :eyes:

liam: I'll finalize the catalog entry and add the per-route gating example config:```yaml
routes:
  - name: legal-qa
    model: athena-6b
    variant: fp16
  - name: search-snippets
    model: athena-6b
    variant: awq-6-4
    traffic_pct: 10
```

maya: Great. Action items: @liam finalize catalog (due EOD tomorrow), @olivia complete quant report + attach logs (due tomorrow noon), @drew run regression harness and sign-off (due tomorrow 4pm), @sam finalize announcement + docs (due Wed 9am). I'll post final go/no-go thread Wed 10am.

qa-bot: Regression harness queued (job id 6789). Results will be posted here when ready.

sam: One more ask — marketing wants a one-liner and 2 bullets about ideal workloads. I'll send copy after catalog is finalized.

maya: Thanks all. This thread will be the canonical coordination thread for Athena-6B bring-up. Ping here for updates. :thumbsup:
